title: Widget arbitrary file deletion (CVE-2026-4242)
summary: Widget 2.1 permits arbitrary file deletion with administrator interaction.
content: Widget 2.1 permits arbitrary file deletion when an administrator renames an attachment.

ttps.evidence: Audit records show an HTTP POST to /rename before file deletion.

hunt_leads.lead: Review POST requests to /rename preceding unexplained file deletion.
